scope_note: The pharmacy change and closure pair, repaired after the V7 round and re-sealed at content version 2. The repair supplies the 14-calendar-day Manager of Record notices in 247 CMR 20.05(1) and (3), which the section had taught as having no clock at all, the seller's controlled-substance duties under 247 CMR 6.14, the federal registration transfer and modification procedures, the 247 CMR 6.15(2) and 6.15(4) remodel requirements and their differing pharmacy-type lists, and the 247 CMR 6.10(3) suitability factors that govern a change of manager. Five additive rules carry that law. MA-Q-0361 was kept: the repaired section now teaches 247 CMR 6.03(10) and (11), on which its key rests. Scope gate: SG-MA-PHARMACY-CLOSURE has no actionable signal; SG-MA-PHARMACY-LICENSURE-CHANGES used the one it had, MA-ENGINEERING-CONTROL-APPROVAL, which surfaced four compounding-practice and compounding-licence neighbours in exchange. Those four are declined: licence acquisition and compounding practice standards are other sections' declared subjects, and citing them would widen this section past the changes a licensed pharmacy must report or seek approval for.
